title: Tier changed
description: A member's tier changed. `direction` is `UP` when the tier rose in the same transaction as the earn that crossed its threshold, and `DOWN` when the daily evaluation lowered it. `qualifyingSpend` is the spend over the program's tier window that decided the tier. The event's `aggregate` is `member/<memberId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

memberId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the member.

externalRef.description: The Tenant's reference for the member.

fromTier.description: The tier the member held before the change.

toTier.description: The tier the member holds after the change.

direction.description: UP for a rise on an earn, DOWN for a fall in the daily evaluation.

qualifyingSpend.description: The eligible net spend over the program's tier window that decided the tier, in minor units of the program's currency.
